About the Practice

Phoenix Children's Hospital is one of the nation's largest pediatric healthcare systems and Arizona's only children's hospital recognized by U.S. News & World Report's Best Children's Hospitals. [6, 12, 13] It is a freestanding pediatric acute care hospital providing comprehensive pediatric specialties and subspecialties, including inpatient, outpatient, emergency, trauma, and urgent care to patients from infancy to young adulthood across Arizona and the Southwest. [5, 6] The system delivers care across more than 75 pediatric specialties and houses six Centers of Excellence, including a Level One Pediatric Trauma Center. [5, 6, 12, 13] Its mission is to advance hope, healing, and the best healthcare for children and their families. [10, 12]

Electronic Health Record System

Altera Digital Health

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Phoenix Children's Hospital utilizes a platform called the "Phoenix Children's Patient Portal" for parents and patients to manage their health information online. Based on the information gathered, Phoenix Children's Hospital has partnered with Altera Digital Health and uses their Sunrise electronic health record (EHR) system. While the search results clearly identify the patient portal by the name "Phoenix Children's Patient Portal", it is highly probable that this patient portal is the offering provided by Altera Digital Health designed to integrate with or be a part of their Sunrise EHR system, similar to how Epic's patient portal is branded as MyChart. Although an older article mentioned integration with an Allscripts EMR in 2018, a more recent result highlights the partnership with Altera Digital Health and the use of the Sunrise EHR.
